verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no batch or bulk endpoint, bulk-edit feature, or multi-item CLI/MCP operation. Broadcasts sending one message to many recipients are a messaging feature, and warehouse reverse-ETL syncs are data ingestion; neither is a bulk-operations capability. General claims that the CLI/MCP can do 'anything' are building blocks an agent could loop over, not documented bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
